'''10,000,000,000''' ('''ten billion''') is the [[natural number]] following 9,999,999,999 and preceding 10,000,000,001.

In [[scientific notation]], it is written as 10<sup>10</sup>. It can be also written in [[tetration]] notation as <sup>2</sup>10.

10,000,000,000 is also the [[Fifth power (algebra)|fifth power]] of [[100 (number)|100]] and also the [[Square (algebra)|square]] of [[100,000]].
